description: This Java source file defines an abstract class SoftRefCacheLine that extends CacheLine. It manages cache entries with soft references, allowing the garbage collector to reclaim memory under pressure. The class includes methods for retrieving the cached value, canceling (clearing the reference), and is designed for cache line management within a cache implementation.

classes.name: SoftRefCacheLine
classes.description: An abstract class that manages cache lines with soft references to values, allowing values to be garbage collected under memory pressure.

methods.name: SoftRefCacheLine
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the soft reference cache line with a value, load time, and expiration time.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Clears the soft reference, effectively invalidating the cache entry.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the cached value from the soft reference.
